subject: NimbusPay — GDPR DPA & SCC options (post-call recap)
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@nimbuspay.com>, Amit Rao <amit.rao@nimbuspay.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: NimbusPay — GDPR DPA & SCC options (post-call recap)

Hi Samira / Amit,

Thanks again for the call this morning — good to meet the security and legal side of the team. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on what we discussed: 

- SOC 2: you mentioned NimbusPay is currently SOC 2 in-progress with an expected report by end of Q2 2027. Please send the SOC 2 readiness summary when available.
- DPA: you asked for a Redwood Data Processing Agreement. I attached our DPA template (redwood-dpa-template_v2.docx) for your review — we usually start from ours and adapt for customer-specific clauses.
- SCC module: you asked which SCC module we expect to sign under EU Standard Contractual Clauses. Redwood typically signs as Processor and prefers Module Two (Processor-to-Controller). If your legal team prefers a different mapping please let us know.
- Controller/Processor alignment: from the product discussion, Redwood will process payments-related data on your behalf; our view is Redwood = Processor. Confirming that with you is high priority.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Samira, please share NimbusPay's vendor security questionnaire and the SOC 2 timeline by EOD Monday 2/22.
2) We (Redwood) will provide: updated DPA draft, subprocessors list, and a short summary of SCC module implications by Tuesday 2/23.
3) Agree SCC module (Module Two preferred) and schedule legal-to-legal call if there are redlines.

Attachments: redwood-dpa-template_v2.docx (draft DPA), call recording stub attached in the thread.

Thanks — I looped in Rishi and Priyom for legal/contract guidance.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@nimbuspay.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Amit Rao <amit.rao@nimbuspay.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NimbusPay — GDPR DPA & SCC options (post-call recap)

Thanks Vanessa — great recap and appreciated. A few notes from our side: 

- SOC 2: we are mid-readiness and have a target to complete the Type II audit by 2027-06-30. We can share a SOC 2 readiness memo and our security controls mapping by Monday.
- Vendor Questionnaire: attached is our standard vendor security questionnaire (Nimbus_Vendor_Questionnaire_v1.pdf). Please complete and return; several of our procurement checkpoints depend on it.
- SCC module: our legal team usually starts from Module Two when the vendor is clearly a Processor. That seems to match your assessment, but we'll confirm internally. If Redwood takes the Processor role, Module Two will be our path.
- Controller/Processor: for the payments flow we view NimbusPay as Controller for customer payment data; we need an explicit statement from Redwood confirming Processor role and a subprocessors list.

We're happy to proceed on the MAP approach you suggested. For next steps we need: Redwood's completed questionnaire, DPA draft, subprocessors list, and any SOC 2 artifacts you can share. I'll loop in our procurement lead if anything needs DocuSign.

Attachments: Nimbus_Vendor_Questionnaire_v1.pdf

Best,
Samira Khan
Head of Security, NimbusPay
samira.khan@nimbuspay.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NimbusPay — GDPR DPA & SCC options (post-call recap)

Vanessa — quick legal/priv policy notes to align before we send anything to Nimbus: 

1) Controller vs Processor: product/product-contract alignment looks clear: Redwood acts as Processor for the services described. We'll provide a short statement in the DPA confirming Processor status and the limited processing activities.
2) SCC module: recommend we indicate Module Two (Processor) as the primary SCC module in the DPA. If Nimbus insists otherwise, escalate to legal-to-legal for negotiation.
3) Subprocessors: compile our current subprocessor list (hosting, monitoring, telemetry). Priyom, can you create the canonical list and include country and data access purpose? We should include expected timelines for adding/removing subs.
4) SOC 2: we can provide a SOC 2 readiness summary and controls mapping; we should avoid promising a report date beyond what Audit gives us.

Action items:
- Priyom to produce subprocessors list and export the internal security summary (due Tue 2/23).
- Neha to review the redwood-dpa-template_v2.docx and add an explicit SCC Module Two clause and a brief Processor statement (due Tue 2/23).

I will review any subsequent Nimbus redlines. Keep the MAP focused on legal deliverables and timelines so procurement can track.

-Rishi
General Counsel (Contracts & Privacy) | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@nimbuspay.com>, Amit Rao <amit.rao@nimbuspay.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NimbusPay — GDPR DPA & SCC options (post-call recap)

Samira / Amit — thanks, and appreciate the questionnaire. 

Short update from our side (following internal alignment):
- Redwood confirms position as Processor for the services discussed and will reflect this in the DPA.
- We will propose SCC Module Two (Processor) in the DPA draft; if Nimbus prefers alternate mapping we can set up legal-to-legal next week.
- Priyom will send the subprocessor spreadsheet and a brief description of data access for each vendor.
- Neha will update the DPA template to include a clear Module Two note and a short exception process for subprocessors.

Proposed mutual action plan (MAP):
1) Tue 2/23 — Redwood sends: updated DPA (Module Two), subprocessor list, SOC 2 readiness memo.
2) Wed 2/24 — Nimbus returns completed vendor questionnaire + any initial redlines on the DPA.
3) By Thu 3/10 — target: finalize DPA and complete signatures (DocuSign link to be used if both sides agree).

I attached a short MAP summary (MAP-NimbusPay-v1.pdf) for tracking. Please confirm the timeline and whether procurement should expect anything else from us.

Thanks — will wait for your confirmation so we can update HubSpot and move to next stage.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
